topic_of_day.title: Should AI be granted legal personhood?
topic_of_day.description: Debate whether artificial intelligence systems should have legal rights and responsibilities similar to corporations or individuals.

trending.title: Is globalization more beneficial or harmful to developing nations?
trending.description: Examine the impact of globalization on economic growth, cultural identity, and sovereignty of developing countries.

trending.title: Should the United Nations Security Council be reformed?
trending.description: Discuss whether the current UNSC structure with five permanent members and veto power is still relevant.

trending.title: Was the British Empire a net positive or negative for its colonies?
trending.description: Analyze the long-term impact of British colonialism on infrastructure, governance, culture, and economy.

trending.title: Is English linguistic dominance a form of cultural imperialism?
trending.description: Debate whether the global spread of English undermines linguistic diversity and local cultures.

trending.title: Should cryptocurrency replace traditional fiat currencies?
trending.description: Examine the viability, risks, and benefits of decentralized digital currencies replacing government-backed money.

trending.title: Is nuclear energy the best solution to climate change?
trending.description: Weigh the benefits of nuclear power against its risks in the context of the global energy crisis.

trending.title: Did the Treaty of Versailles cause World War II?
trending.description: Analyze whether the punitive terms of the Treaty of Versailles directly led to the rise of fascism and WWII.

trending.title: Should universal basic income be implemented globally?
trending.description: Debate the economic feasibility and social impact of providing unconditional income to all citizens.
